jobs.title: Director of Go-to-Market Engineering
jobs.description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. About the Role We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering . Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it. You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations , lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter. This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace. The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV. What You'll Do Own the strategy and the stack Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together. Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself. Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams. Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback. Build, hands-on Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production. Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails. Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely. Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript. Automate across SDR, AE, and AM Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution. jobs.title: Product Engineer / Builder
jobs.description: Why this role exists Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel. Tacto is building the intelligence layer between bits and atoms, connecting the digital world of engineering with the physical world of manufacturing. It’s how AI gets into the real economy. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto. We’re the category leader in DACH, backed by Sequoia and Index, and we’re just getting started. What you'll do Find the problems worth solving, then solve them end to end. Talk to customers, build across the whole stack, and ship to production. Turn what AI can do today into features that procurement and engineering teams use every day. You’re done when it drives revenue, not when it’s merged. Don’t wait for a PRD. What we mean by Builder Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles. A Builder takes a messy, unclear problem and owns it from start to finish. That goes for business problems, not just customer problems. You decide what’s worth doing, make the case for it, test the risky parts early, and see it through until it pays off. When something works, you share it so everyone gets better. We care about outcomes, not code quality for its own sake. What makes this fun is the loop from idea to reality, and AI just made that loop 10x shorter. There’s no room here for “my job is to solve interesting technical problems.” How we build - The Tacto Engineer Builder is the what. The Tacto Engineer is the how. It’s our engineering practice and the bar we hold each other to. Wear the customer’s shoes. Ship fast, finish fully. Sweat the details. Get 1% better every week. No lone wolves. Use AI as leverage, not a crutch. Read the full version at en.tacto.ai/engineering . If it reads like the way you already work, you’ll fit in here. Who we're looking for Hungry, creative, AI pilled engineers at every level of seniority who care more about the result than the craft. You have your own ideas and act on them, whether that’s something you started, a side project, or a feature nobody asked for that turned out to matter. You’ve shipped real production software in a modern product team. Experience with B2B SaaS or data products is a plus. You work in Cursor, Claude, Codex and agents every day, and you’ve built something with them that wouldn’t exist otherwise. You go deep in modern Python (FastAPI, async, SQL) or TypeScript/React/Next.js, and you’re happy to work anywhere in the stack. You’ve built AI features into a product, or you’re obsessively learning how. You want to be in a room full of people who are fired up about what they’re building. Stack Python, FastAPI, Postgres, and ClickHouse on the backend. React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, and Storybook on the frontend. GitHub, Linear, and Figma for everything around it. For AI, whatever ships fastest. How we work We’re in our Munich office four days a week, with 100+ people building together every day. We measure outcomes, not hours. Trust is high and feedback is direct. Competitive salary and meaningful equity. 26 + 4 vacation days, Wellpass fitness membership, JobRad bike leasing, company pension plan, and a childcare (Kita) subsidy. Our Background Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material. jobs.title: Marketing Associate – Special Projects & Events
jobs.description: Marketing Associate – Special Projects & Events Festanstellung · Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ) Unsere Mission für dich Du baust den Kanal, über den trawa dem industriellen Mittelstand begegnet: mehr als 30 Messen, Kongresse und Roundtables im Jahr, von der fünftägigen Leitmesse bis zum Fachkongress auf sechs Quadratmetern. Du entscheidest mit, welche davon stattfinden, führst sie durch und stehst für das Ergebnis ein. Es bleibt nicht beim Stand. Du baust die Landingpage, bewirbst die Events in Paid und Content und schreibst den LinkedIn-Post zur Messewoche. In kurzer Zeit kennst du den kompletten Weg von der Standfläche bis zur Opportunity im CRM — eine Breite, die dir ein großes Marketingteam nicht bietet. Europas B2B-Sektor gibt jährlich über 200 Milliarden Euro für Energie aus. Die Zeit, diesen Markt zu dekarbonisieren und unsere Markenbekanntheit zu steigern, ist jetzt. Das Team Neben dir sitzen Content, Growth und Product Marketing — Events sind der Kanal, an dem alle drei zusammenlaufen. Gleichzeitig bist du näher an Sales als die meisten Marketingrollen. Auf jeder Messe stehen Seller mit am Stand, und der Wert eines Events entsteht erst, wenn aus Gesprächen Termine werden. Du stimmst dich laufend mit Sales, SDRs und Revenue Operations ab. Deine Aufgaben Du ownst den Eventkalender. Welche Messe, welches Format, welches Budget. Du planst das Jahr, rechnest jedes Event durch und sagst ab, wenn die Zahl nicht stimmt. Du baust den Auftritt. Standfläche, Standbau, Grafik, Technik, Logistik. Du verhandelst mit Messegesellschaften und Dienstleistern, hältst die Fristen ein und stehst vor Ort selbst am Stand. Du machst aus Standtagen Termine. Einladungskampagnen, Teilnehmerlisten, Matchmaking, Terminsetzung vorab. Danach: Lead-Erfassung, Nachfass und Übergabe an Sales entlang eines klaren SLA. Du misst deine eigene Arbeit. Landingpages, Formulare, HubSpot-Workflows, Lead-Tagging und Reporting baust du selbst — und berichtest MQLs, Pipeline und Signings je Event gegen Plan. Du bleibst nicht bei Events. Newsletter, LinkedIn, PR und eigene Formate gehören dazu, bis hin zu Guerilla-Experimenten wie Briefkampagnen oder OOH. Was funktioniert, wiederholen wir. Nach wem wir suchen Ein bis vier Jahre B2B-Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Events oder Messen, gern mit Bezug zum deutschen Mittelstand Du bist extrovertiert: Auf dem Stand gehst du auf Menschen zu, statt zu warten, bis jemand stehen bleibt. Viele Gespräche am Tag geben dir Energie Du behältst den Überblick, wenn ein Dutzend Dienstleister und mehrere Messen parallel laufen – und eskalierst rechtzeitig Du denkst kaufmännisch und bewertest ein Event an dem, was es an Pipeline bringt Du baust dir Landingpage, Formular und Reporting selbst Bias to Action: lieber schnell testen und messen als lange konzipieren Deutsch muttersprachlich, gutes Englisch Berlin oder Umzug dorthin, plus Reisebereitschaft in der Messesaison und einen Führerschein Deine ersten 90 Tage: Nach sechs Wochen: Onboarding Du hast trawas Geschäftsmodell, Produkt und Zielgruppe im Detail verstanden und alle relevanten Stakeholder in Marketing und Sales kennengelernt. Du hast das laufende Eventportfolio übernommen, kennst jeden offenen Punkt und jede Frist und hast die Abläufe dokumentiert. Du warst auf allen Messen vor Ort, die in dieser Zeit stattfanden, und hast konkrete Verbesserungen benannt und erste Verantwortung übernommen. Im dritten Monat: Ramp-up Du verantwortest eigene Key Results im neuen Planungszyklus und lässt dich an den erzielten Ergebnissen messen. Du hast die Planung für das kommende Halbjahr aufgesetzt, jedes Event durchgerechnet und einen Entscheidungsvorschlag vorgelegt. Ein wiederverwendbarer Ablauf steht: Vorlauf, Aktivierung, Lead-Erfassung, Nachfass — nachvollziehbar genug, dass jemand anderes ihn ausführen könnte.. Warum wir? Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft und treibe eigenverantwortlich Projekte voran, die echten Einfluss auf unsere Produkte, unsere Kund:innen und die Umwelt habe

jobs.title: (Senior) Associate – Energy Markets & Business Development (Railway Power & PPAs)
jobs.description: (Senior) Associate – Energy Markets & Business Development (Railway Power & PPAs) Our mission for you European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk - and companies need to act now. trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, Flex - combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings - all while helping companies switch to renewable energy. We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast - the market window is open and we intend to own it. About trawa trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future. We're looking for a (Senior) Associate – Energy Markets & Business Development (Railway Power & PPAs) to own an important part of our energy value chain. You'll report directly to our Energy Operations Manager with close collaboration with the COO and Trading Team. You'll shape the product that makes European industry competitive again - and you'll do it at pace. This role is based in Berlin. trawa is an "office first" company, which means you will work from the office typically five days per week. The Team You'll join our Energy Operations team, which owns the energy side of our business - from sourcing and portfolio management to making sure our customers' energy products work in practice. You'll work hand in hand with our Trading Team as well as with Sales, Pricing, Product and Tech. You start without direct reports, but with a clear mandate: build and grow the business areas you own. What you'll do As (Senior) Associate – Energy Markets & Business Development, you combine a strong analytical mind with business building: Build our railway power business: A significant share of our customers comes from the railway power (Bahnstrom) segment. You take ownership of this segment from a trading and energy perspective - you understand its specific market setup, improve how we forecast, source, price and supply railway power, and make us the go-to partner for these customers. You dig into how we currently predict our railway customers' energy demand and find ways to make these forecasts more accurate. You also build partnerships with IT service providers from the railway industry and with infrastructure operators. Lead international railway expansion: You drive the expansion of our railway power offering into further European countries - you analyse market structures, regulation and commercial potential, and contribute your findings into a concrete go-to-market plan. Expand our long-term product offering: Our customers buy long-term products from us, such as PPAs and Future/Forwards products. You develop our offering so we can provide more and better-fitting products to our customers. Architect of the long-term trading process: You centralise and streamline the end-to-end process from pricing and offer creation to actual trade execution across Sales, Pricing, Trading and Operations - making it faster, more robust and scalable, and ultimately enabling a better product for our customers. Bridge between trading and business: You work closely with our quant trading and data science team and turn their models and insights into processes and systems that work across teams and markets - so that pricing, risk and market insights reliably translate into better decisions and products

This highly strategic, customer-facing role sits at the intersection of product, sales, and sports. Instead, your success will be measured by driving product adoption, enabling the sales organization, influencing product direction through customer feedback, and helping close strategic opportunities where sports expertise is essential. In This Role You Will Serve as the subject matter expert for ElevenLabs’ sports use cases, supporting enterprise sales opportunities from discovery through deployment. Partner closely with Account Executives throughout the sales cycle, providing product expertise, customer education, and strategic guidance. Drive adoption across professional sports leagues, teams, federations, broadcasters, streaming platforms, rights holders, agencies, sports technology companies, and other organizations across the sport

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager / Key Account Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: hellomed ist die führende digitale Pflege-Apotheke für Pflegeunternehmen – nach dem Motto: Dauermedikation nur in einfach! Unsere Vision ist es, bis 2030 die jährlichen 250.000 Krankenhauseinweisungen aufgrund von Medikationsfehlern und die damit verbundenen 1,2 Milliarden Euro Folgekosten zu vermeiden und der Pflege wieder zurückzugeben. Mit unserer innovativen hellomedOS-Software entlasten wir Pflegekräfte bei der täglichen Medikationsversorgung ihrer Patienten und machen diese noch sicherer. Unser revolutionäres Konzept bringen wir mit einem bunten Team aus Apothekern, Pflegeexperten und Entwicklern auf die Straße – namhafte Investoren sind bereits mit an Bord und Pflegekräfte deutschlandweit lieben das Produkt. Für unsere größten Kunden – Träger und Pflegeunternehmen mit mehreren Standorten – suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die diese Partnerschaften betreut, ausbaut und unsere Kundenbetreuung mit uns gemeinsam weiterentwickelt. Aufgaben Großkunden betreuen: Du betreust unsere größten Pflegeunternehmen und Träger – von der Einführung bis zur langfristigen Zusammenarbeit – und bist feste Ansprechperson für Geschäftsführungen, Regional- und Pflegedienstleitungen. Versorgung im Alltag sichern: Du sorgst dafür, dass alle vereinbarten Patienten auch tatsächlich über hellomed versorgt werden, und schulst Pflegeteams und Leitungen im sicheren Umgang mit hellomedOS – vor Ort und digital. Kundenbeziehungen ausbauen: Du erkennst, wo wir bei bestehenden Kunden weitere Standorte und Patienten versorgen können, und setzt das gemeinsam mit unserem Vertrieb um. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich im Wachstum deiner Kundenbeziehungen. Gespräche auf Leitungsebene: Du führst regelmäßige Gespräche mit den Geschäftsführungen deiner Kunden – was läuft gut, wo gibt es Potenzial, was braucht der Kunde als Nächstes? Kundenbetreuung mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit den Gründern entwickelst du unsere Abläufe in der Kundenbetreuung weiter und gibst deine Erfahrung an Kollegen im Team weiter. Verantwortung übernehmen: Mit wachsendem Team übernimmst du zunehmend Verantwortung für unsere gesamte Customer-Success-Funktion. Mit deiner Arbeit hilfst du dabei, unsere Vision zu verwirklichen und die Medikationsversorgung in der Pflege nachhaltig zu verbessern. Qualifikation Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Betreuung oder im Ausbau von Geschäftskunden mit, zum Beispiel als Key Account Manager, Kundenbetreuer oder im Vertrieb, idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen. Alternativ hast du Leitungserfahrung in der Pflege (z. B. als Pflegedienst-, Einrichtungs- oder Regionalleitung) und Freude an Kundenkontakt und Wachstum. Erfahrung mit großen Kunden: Du hast bereits Kunden mit mehreren Standorten betreut und trittst gegenüber Geschäftsführungen sicher und überzeugend auf. Kommunikationsstärke: Du erklärst komplexe Sachverhalte klar und verständlich und baust schnell Vertrauen auf – bei Pflegekräften ebenso wie bei Geschäftsführern. Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest zuverlässig und organisiert, behältst auch bei mehreren großen Kunden den Überblick und hast ein gutes Gespür für Zahlen. Technische Offenheit: Du arbeitest sicher mit digitalen Anwendungen. Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System oder Pflegesoftware ist von Vorteil. Reisebereitschaft: Du besuchst unsere Kunden regelmäßig vor Ort (max. 1/3 der Arbeitszeit). Haltung statt Lebenslauf: Startup-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung – entscheidend sind deine Erfahrung und dein Anspruch an gute Kundenbetreuung. Benefits Wir bieten dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag mit Arbeitsplatz in unserem brandneuen Büro am Mehringdamm im Herzen Berlin-Kreuzbergs, mit guter Verkehrsanbindung. Du profitierst von einer überdurchschnittlichen Bezahlung mit attraktiver Bonuskomponente, die sich am Wachstum deiner Kundenbeziehungen orientiert. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für eine ganze Funktion und arbeitest direkt an der Seite der hellomed-Gründer – mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Freiraum für eigene Ide

jobs.title: Product Manager, Homepage
jobs.description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right. Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order. What You'll Be Doing You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app. Here's what your day-to-day might look like: Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products. Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why. Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order. Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all. What You'll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest: Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant. You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them. You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now. You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions. You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own. You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next. You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all). You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype. Next steps The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us! Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Beware

jobs.title: DSP Engineer - Werkstudent
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><h3>Your Impact</h3> <p>This is a hands-on opportunity to apply what you're learning about signal processing to a real product that keeps people and critical infrastructure safe. As a Working Student on our RF Engineering team in Kassel, you'll work alongside experienced DSP engineers — prototyping algorithms, analyzing real RF captures, and building the tooling that helps us detect and classify drones in the wild. You'll grow your practical DSP and software skills on real-world data, with mentorship and room to take ownership of meaningful pieces of work.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p><strong>Work Location: </strong>This role is based out of our Kassel office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.<br><strong>Reports to:</strong> Team Lead</p> <ul> <li>Help prototype, implement, and test DSP algorithms in Python and C++.</li> <li>Analyze recorded RF / I/Q captures and help characterize drone and controller signals.</li> <li>Build and improve scripts and tooling for signal analysis, data handling, and visualization.</li> <li>Run experiments and document results to support detection and classification work.</li> </ul> <h3>What You Bring</h3> <ul> <li>Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.</li> <li>Coursework or project experience in DSP fundamentals (e.g., sampling, filtering, FFT/spectral analysis, modulation).</li> <li>Programming experience in Python and/or C++.</li> <li>Genuine curiosity about RF / wireless and signal processing, and an eagerness to learn on real data.</li> <li>Good communication skills in English; German is a plus.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.</p> <p>Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</p> <p><strong>Important Notes</strong></p> <p><em>The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. jobs.title: Senior Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Keyfactor&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><span data-teams="true">Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. jobs.description: About the Role at RobCo RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time. As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work. jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer - Berlin
jobs.description: About RA Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture. Purpose of the role As our Senior QA Engineer, you'll look after the quality of ra.co , our iOS and Android apps, and RA Scan, the app promoters use to scan tickets at the door. You'll work across five product teams. Each team writes and runs its own tests. You'll help them do it well, keep the automated test suites healthy, and test the riskiest releases yourself. Some of what we ship carries real risk: payments, checkout, and getting people into venues on the night. Other changes are a line of copy. You'll help us tell the two apart and test each one accordingly. We use AI tools across development, and you'll help the teams use them to write better tests, faster. Key responsibilities Keep the web end-to-end test suite healthy: fix flaky tests, add coverage for new features, and make sure a failing suite gets fixed quickly Grow automated testing for our iOS and Android apps and RA Scan with the app developers, so mobile tests run on every change Test high-risk releases yourself, such as payments and checkout, including edge cases and what happens when things fail Review the test plans teams write, and help them improve Use AI tools to write and maintain tests, help developers do the same, and check what the tools produce Brief our external testing partner and review the results they send back Report bugs clearly, and follow them through with developers and product managers Track a few simple measures, such as bugs that reach production and how reliable the automated tests are We’re looking for Several years in QA or test engineering, typically four or more, testing web and mobile products Hands-on test automation: you've built and maintained automated tests that run in CI, for web (for example Playwright, Cypress or Selenium) and ideally mobile. We use XCUITest on iOS and Espresso with Kotlin on Android Enough coding to write and fix tests alongside developers, in a language such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Kotlin or Swift You can test APIs and check data with SQL Good judgement about risk: what to test deeply, what lightly, and what not at all You've used AI tools in your testing work, and know where they help and where they don't Clear writing: bug reports and test plans other people can act on If you meet most of these but not all, we'd still like to hear from you. Nobody arrives with all of it, and we'll help you grow into the rest. Nice to have CircleCI or a similar CI tool Working with an external testing partner Payments, checkout or ticketing systems Testing apps used at live events, with poor networks Test management tools such as Qase or TestRail What we offer you Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance. Matched pension, or 401k for US staff. Comprehensive staff wellbeing initiatives, featuring regular activities and workplace programmes to support mental and physical health. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs. Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on merch. Paid annual volunteering allowance, encouraging contributions to community projects and charities you care about. A transparent internal company culture committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (see: https://ra.co/about/diversity ). Active involvement in community projects within the electronic music community

jobs.title: Interim Senior BI Analyst (All Genders)
jobs.description: Across Europe, fleets are under enormous pressure. Fuel costs are rising. Regulatory requirements are tightening. The shift to low-emission vehicles is accelerating. And yet around 70% of European businesses still manage their fleets manually, with spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and processes that were never built for this moment. Shiftmove exists to make this simple. We are a profitable B2B SaaS company and the fastest-growing fleet management platform in Europe, born from the merger of Avrios and Vimcar, and now serving tens of thousands of corporate customers across Germany, France, Spain, Switzerland, Poland, and beyond. Most recently, we acquired Optimum and Ocean in France, expanding our footprint and doubling down on one of Europe's largest fleet markets. Our AI-powered platform connects real-time vehicle data with intelligent software so that businesses can procure smarter, control costs, stay compliant, and lead the transition to cleaner mobility, all from one place. About the role: We are looking for an experienced Interim Senior BI Analyst to join us on an initial three-month contract, with the option to extend for a further three months. As we integrate two acquired French businesses into our group, we need to bring their data into our standard reporting while transforming how our executive team accesses and uses business intelligence. Our existing Tableau dashboards have evolved over time, and we see an opportunity to make them clearer, more consistent and more actionable. Reporting to our VP of Operations, Data & BI , you will work closely with the executive team, Head of FP&A, RevOps and Data Engineering. You will take ownership of rebuilding our executive reporting, responding to daily analytical requests and ensuring that acquired-company data is accurately reflected in group-wide reporting. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong technical BI skills with commercial acumen, sound analytical judgement and the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders when the data tells a different story. What You'll Do Rebuild executive reporting: Audit our existing Tableau dashboards and the underlying business logic. Decide which dashboards to retain, consolidate, redesign or retire, and rebuild the priority dashboards so executives can quickly understand performance and make informed decisions Establish consistent metrics: Document and align metric definitions to ensure that business performance is measured consistently across dashboards, teams and entities Own daily ad hoc reporting: Manage requests through our Jira-based data support queue, prioritising, scoping and delivering analyses on a daily basis. Translate ambiguous requests into clear business questions and identify recurring needs that can be addressed through standard reporting Integrate acquisition data: Partner with Data Engineering as acquired-company data is migrated into Snowflake. Validate and reconcile data against source systems, build and maintain dbt models, and incorporate the data into existing Tableau dashboards so group reporting reflects all entities Deliver commercial insights: Translate executive requirements into meaningful analysis of go-to-market performance, including pipeline, bookings, ARR, retention and churn Partner with Finance: Work closely with the Head of FP&A to reconcile BI reporting with financial figures and establish a consistent view of business performance Present findings and challenge assumptions: Communicate insights directly to the executive team, explain what the data means for the business, and challenge assumptions where the evidence supports a different conclusion Enable a smooth handover: Document dashboards, data models, metric definitions and reporting processes so the permanent BI team can take ownership of the work at the end of the interim period What You Need to Succeed You bring extensive experience in BI or analytics , including at least three years working at a senior level Yo

jobs.description: Powering Great Work We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists: 🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business 🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time 🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country As our next Account Executive, you'll help bring more trades onto Checkatrade across different regions and categories. It's a new business role: you find high-potential trade businesses and guide them from the first conversation to a signed deal. You'll sit in our Strategic Growth team, at the heart of how we grow the trade network that homeowners rely on. The job, unfiltered: Win new trade businesses by finding high-potential small and medium trades, building proposals that make sense for them and negotiating terms. Hand each new trade over smoothly to our vetting team, so the start of their Checkatrade journey goes well. Spot opportunities in the market, using data and insights to see where Checkatrade is strong and where we can grow. Work with Account Management, Vetting, Product and Operations to find the regions and categories that would benefit most from Checkatrade. Learn our product suite inside out, so every business case is tailored to the prospect in front of you. Own the outbound sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through to proposals, negotiation and closing. The fit: Solid experience in commercial or new business sales, ideally in similar markets, with a strong focus on outbound acquisition. A track record of finding new clients, building tailored proposals and hitting revenue targets. The knack for building strong relationships with tradespeople, and working closely with colleagues across teams. Confidence juggling multiple priorities and improving how things get done. Experience building customer relationships, whether through digital outreach or face-to-face conversations. Tenacity and resilience. This is a test-and-learn environment where persistence matters. Nice to have: familiarity with CRM systems (Salesforce) and outbound tools, and an understanding of AI-powered optimisation tools. (Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.) What you get 💰 Competitive salary, annual bonus & equity scheme 🩺 Health, wellbeing and learning support 🚲 Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme, Cycle Scheme 🎂 Birthday/special day leave, buy & sell holiday scheme ❤️ 1 week's paid charity leave, and more How this goes Screening call with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners 1st stage interview with our Head of Sales SMB 2nd stage interview with our Head of Sales SMB and Sales Operations Manager 3rd stage interview with our VP of Sales Not this one? Stay close anyway. Join the Talent Community and we'll ping you the second something better fits. About us We’re Checkatrade – the UK’s leading platform for finding a tradesperson. With more than 50,000 trades listed and over 6 million reviews, we help homeowners get jobs done right and help tradespeople grow their business. We’re growing fast, with big plans to become the go-to brand for home improvements. If you care about great work, take pride in the details, and want to make an impact, you’ll fit right in. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. You’ll quickly establish yourself as the go-to TA partner for hiring managers in the org: consulting on best practices, sharing insights and reports, and continuously improving our talent acquisition function. You’ll help us make the right hiring decisions, bringing in top talent who are also a strong Relay fit. Who Will Thrive in this role? You own end-to-end hiring: you can run the full lifecycle from sourcing and outreach through to offer, while keeping quality and pace high. You’re a trusted partner to senior stakeholders: you build strong relationships with Business and Ops Leadership and People, align on priorities, and help translate plans into hiring action. You’re operationally excellent: you create sharp JDs and scorecards, keep pipelines clean in Ashby, coordinate smoothly across hiring managers/agencies, and produce high-quality candidate packs/interview kits. You leverage systems and tools to scale impact: you use the ATS expertly and you’re curious and proactive about new tooling (sourcing tools, automation, AI) that improves productivity and quality of hire. You use data to drive decisions: you track and act on key TA metrics (sourcing activity, time-to-fill, time-in-stage, offer acceptance, candidate/HM satisfaction) and keep stakeholders clearly informed. You improve the machine, not just run it: you spot bottlenecks, propose fixes, and implement changes that improve speed, quality, and candidate experience. Must-Haves Proven track record as a Senior Recruiter or Talent Acquisition Lead.. Background in hypergrowth startups or scale-ups. Structured, clear communicator with strong stakeholder management. Data-driven mindset, using metrics to prioritise, iterate and improve outcomes. Compensation & Benefits & Workplace Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups , with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success. Private health & dental coverage , so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it. 25 days of holidays Enhanced parental leave . Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote. Hardware of your choice . Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more). Fast and Focused Hiring Process Talent Acquisition Interview - 45 min Hiring Manager Interview - 60 min Case Study - 75 min Decision and offer within 48 hours ; our process mirrors our pace of work. jobs.title: Assembly and Test Technician
jobs.description: LOCATION: CALMSDEN, CIRENCESTER, UK. LIMITED FIELD TRAVEL AS REQUIRED | 5 DAYS ONSITE THE LAST FRONTIER ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy. We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to. Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk. THE ROLE ARD is growing and we’re looking for an Assembly and Test Technician to help us build and test our ruggedized hardware - from field-ready energy and battery systems to the autonomous platforms we deploy in the Arctic. Right now, our biggest constraint isn’t design. It’s the time it takes to assemble and test what we’ve designed. Reporting to our Senior Test Engineer , you’ll join our engineering team, working alongside our mechanical and electrical engineers and across our main hardware workstreams. You’ll take hands-on ownership of assembly and testing, helping with the practical implementation and testing of engineering designs. Within your first 3 months, you’ll have helped to take assembly and test off the critical path on our key projects, and helped put in place the documentation and test processes that let us build and test consistently, unit after unit. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Assemble mechanical and electrical sub-assemblies, harnesses, PCBAs, and complete units to drawings and build instructions, so they’re ready for test on schedule. Help set up repeatable test processes, from test plans and rigs to how results are captured, working closely with our Senior Test Engineer. Write and maintain build instructions, test procedures and records, raising the standard of our engineering documentation as we scale. Spot and report problems found during build and test, giving engineers the detail they need to debug and improve the next design revision. REQUIREMENTS About You You’re a practical, hands-on technician who takes pride in building things properly and getting the details right. You’re methodical, you like a clear process, and you’d rather write something down than rely on memory. jobs.title: Talent Partner
jobs.description: Healf is Europe's fastest-growing company. Number one on the FT1000, number one on the Sifted 100. From £1m to over £100m in under three years, with a small, talent-dense team and an electric culture with day one founder intensity. Now we're aiming for £1bn in the next three. We curate the world's best wellbeing brands across The Four Pillars™: EAT, MOVE, MIND, SLEEP. That's the first chapter. The next chapter is harder and more interesting. We are moving from one market to many, from e-commerce to a technology platform, and from curating wellbeing to defining it. We are a health company, so we think we should act like one. At its fullest expression, Healf redefines what wellbeing means for tens of millions of people. We're looking for a generalist Talent Partner to bring firepower to an AI-first talent team indexing heavily on talent density, candidate experience and hiring velocity. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with a few years recruiting experience in high-growth, venture backed companies who thrives on ownership, founder-level agency and building deep relationships with passive candidates in hard-to-hire markets. It's an end-to-end, generalist role; you'll be working across a range of searches from tech to commercial. You'll be based in our London office 3-4 days a week. This IC role is benchmarked for someone earlier in their career- you'll have a steep growth trajectory but it won't be the remit or provide growth for someone who's been longer tenured in a more senior position. Where you'll make an impact Talent density: Building talent networks of hard-to-hire, passive candidates who will move the needle for Healf on the business metrics that matter as we scale past £100m annual revenue. Ensuring meaningful optionality of candidates at offer-stage by running sprint-style, automation-enabled searches. Sourcing, assessing and closing candidates from entry through to senior experience levels. Candidate experience: There are known shortcomings today in our candidate experience and we see this person inputting on initiatives that will enable a more fluid, high-touch hiring process. Delivering exceptional, personalised narratives for candidates that resonate with their individual motivations. Contributing to an evolving candidate experience programme that makes Healf's interview loop a differentiator for candidates. Hiring velocity: Moving fast and being proactive in keeping hiring teams accountable on pace. Automating administrative burdens at top-of-funnel and within talent operations. Bringing exceptional instinct and pattern-spotting skills in understanding who's an exceptional fit for Healf. What you'll bring Bias for action and deep ownership Superb written and verbal communication skills Transparency and natural proclivity for leaning in to challenging conversations Demonstrable personal interest in health and wellbeing Exceptional pattern-spotting and critical thinking ability Excellent storytelling and relationship building ability both internally and externally Demonstrable experience of leveraging AI to level-up a hiring process Confidence learning new spaces and search criteria Positive energy and strong work ethic Our interview process 30 minutes with someone from the Talent team 30 minutes with Director, Talent 60 minutes case study with the Talent team 30 minutes with Lestat, Co-founder The Deal We ask a great deal of the people who work here. We expect full ownership and a genuine commitment to give this chapter everything you have. In return, we will give you the same: everything we have, invested in your growth, your wellbeing, and the defining skills of the next decade. We have built the fastest-growing company in Europe with a team small enough that every person in it shapes the outcome. That is still true today. jobs.title: Pre-Sales / Sales Engineer
jobs.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ The Pre-Sales role ⭐️ Our Pre-Sales team strengthens Alan’s Enterprise and Public sector Sales to better handle the specificities of our largest customers. Here are the main missions of the team you will join: Master our platform and support Sales team by enabling them with insights, expertise and the relevant tools; Listen and understand prospects’ needs and work internally on how Alan can address them best; Build a thorough understanding of the prospect and assess the level of functional alignment with our offering and capabilities; Participate to RFP submissions and build Alan’s response in collaboration with Sales, Insurance and Product experts; Join the customer acquisition journey to evangelize our services and products; Act as voice of the customer feeding Alan’s platform roadmap; Prepare handover for delightful customers’ onboardings; Eventually coordinate the most complex customer onboardings leveraging your unique knowledge of the customer’s requirements and specificities. You will actively participate in developing this growing function within Alan and edit the company to make our Sales teams the most successful of all! Given the growing need for onsite customer engagement, this role requires you to be based in Paris or the Île-de-France region (or within a 2-hour door to door distance with the flexibility to travel to Paris on short notice for customer meetings). For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-E level range . ⭐️ You will be a great fit if ⭐️ You have 6+ years of experience working in a SaaS environment, including at least 3 in a Pre-Sales / Sales Engineering / Solution Consultant role. You have a talent for quickly getting to the root cause of customers concern through active listening and requirements elicitation; You are assertive and know how to handle objections in a complex environment; You master the art of pitching a product with transparency and without overselling its capabilities ; You have the ability to break down complex issues and identify product gaps to define the best product solutions; You thrive at high level stakeholders’ management; You excel at prioritizing tasks while living up to commitments; You love teamwork and are always eager to learn and grow; You are fluent in both French and English; It would be even better if you have: Experience with end-to-end procurement projects (buyer or supplier side) with involvement in RFI’s, RFQ’s and RFP’s; Experience in the French Public Sector ; Experience in HRIS ecosystems and Payroll solutions ; Experience in Insurance or Health platforms . 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. T

jobs.title: Product Builder - Mo (AI health companion)
jobs.description: 🤖 Who we are We’re building Mo — a health companion for everyone. We’re a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise . We are building Mo, an intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise - through chat, voice, or video. That’s what we are building 🤖. We kicked off the project in 2023, and we have launched Mo to all our french members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe. 🚀 Why we need you Mo’s scope is expanding fast: inside Alan (a new Clinic, new capabilities), across the countries we operate in, and at the interfaces with many other Alan experiences. To get this expansion right, and to keep ownership distributed within the team, we’re looking for a Product Builder to take on a real share of that complexity and ambiguity. You’ll own end-to-end one slice of Mo’s product scope. Depending on your profile, it could be: 🩺 Mo for reactive care. Build all the integrations between Mo, our Clinic and the healthcare system, and shape how our medical team interacts with members in and through Mo. 🛡️ Mo for insurance. Make Mo the main interface between members and Alan, building on our Support AI agents, across channels and countries. 🌍 Mo global. Adapt Mo to new countries and find the right operating model for each (medical reviews, safety, local features). ➕ Mo as a platform. Make Mo the companion other teams build upon, so our domain experts can ship their own experiences through it. 🎯 Is it you we’re looking for? We’re looking for Product Builders with around 5+ years of experience who want to build state-of-the-art AI products and apply them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare. You’ll own a product area end-to-end: problem framing, vision, prioritisation, shipping, and measuring whether we actually help members get and stay better. You’ll work daily with engineers, ML engineers, data, and doctors, at the frontier of LLMs and agentic systems, and see your work in production with real people. You’ll navigate ambiguity and many stakeholders across Alan, and turn it into clear decisions and a focused roadmap. You’ll be hands-on: prototyping, digging into data, reading conversations and evals, getting into the technical details with the team. You’ll contribute to our product culture and help build the team (hiring, interview loops, etc.). You would be a good fit in Mo if most of this sounds like you: Experience building and shipping a live AI/LLM product Very hands-on, comfortable with technical and data topics (SQL, prototyping, understanding how an LLM system behaves and fails) Interest or experience in one or several medical or prevention themes Product-minded and outcome-driven: you care about impact, not output Self-directed, pragmatic, driven, hard working Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!) Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching Fluent in English Ex-engineers and ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus 🤘 How we do it ? We benefit from Alan’s platform , infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise — but operate with the speed and focus of a startup. If you’re curious about Alan’s broader vision, our Shareholder Letters are worth a read. People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as: How we work: our Leadership Principles Mission is the Boss — We think long-term and are methodical optimists who take risks, seeking our mission's success above all else. Distributed Ownership — Accountable enlightened despots

jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span class="TextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL)</span></span><span data-contrast="none"> is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest </span><span data-contrast="none">health threats. </span><span data-contrast="none">Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. </span><span data-contrast="none">Since 2017, </span><span data-contrast="none">we’ve</span><span data-contrast="none"> worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live</span> <span data-contrast="none">longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><p>Resolve to Save Lives' Prevent Epidemics program works closely with Ministries of Health and national public health institutes in Africa to strengthen epidemic preparedness capacity, accelerate disease detection and response, and effectively use data to inform action. In addition to direct partnerships with governments, we also work with implementing partners, including the US CDC, the World Health Organization, the World Bank, and the Global Health Advocacy Incubator, to implement programs, prototype innovations, and ensure sustainability through increased national ownership, including domestic budget allocations.</p> <h3><strong><span data-contrast="none">Position Purpose</span></strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The Senior Technical Advisor, Data Use and Decision Science, focuses on bridging the gap between complex epidemiological and contextual data and strategic public health action. This role will accompany in-country counterparts to generate stronger analytics and information products to support decision-making, integrating disease surveillance data with other contextual (e.g., climate, environmental, risk, and vulnerability) data. jobs.title: Stage - Juriste Droit du Numérique & Protection des Données Personnelles
jobs.description: 📍 Localisation : Nantes (Ile de Nantes) 📅 Début : ASAP ⏳ Durée : 6 mois 💰 Gratification de stage : conformément au minimum conventionnel en vigueur. Lengow, expert des solutions e-commerce intelligentes  Lengow est un acteur de référence des solutions e-commerce intelligentes, qui accompagne les marques et les distributeurs dans leur croissance rentable sur les canaux digitaux. Grâce à ses solutions performantes de gestion de flux produits, de veille tarifaire internationale et d'analyse de données, Lengow propose une suite complète d'outils SaaS permettant aux e-commerçants d'améliorer la visibilité de leurs produits en ligne, de renforcer leur compétitivité grâce à des stratégies de prix éclairées, de développer leurs ventes sur les marketplaces et de suivre la présence de leur marque auprès des distributeurs. Depuis 2009, Lengow accompagne la croissance digitale de plus de 3 600 clients, sur des milliers de canaux marketing et de vente, dans plus de 60 pays. Votre rôle au sein de la Legal Team Dans le cadre de nos activités, nous recherchons un.e stagiaire Juriste en Droit du Numérique & Protection des Données Personnelles pour rejoindre notre Legal Team. Directement rattaché.e à la Head of Legal, vous participerez activement aux projets juridiques de l'entreprise, avec une attention particulière portée à la conformité RGPD, aux évolutions réglementaires du secteur numérique et aux enjeux liés à l'intelligence artificielle. Vous aurez également l'opportunité de collaborer avec différentes équipes internes (Product, Tech, Sales, Marketing, HR, etc.) et de développer une approche pratique et opérationnelle du droit. Vos missions 1. Protection des données personnelles & conformité RGPD Participer au suivi et à l'amélioration de la conformité de Lengow en matière de protection des données personnelles. Contribuer à la mise à jour du registre des activités de traitement des données personnelles, en collaboration avec les différentes équipes internes. Participer à la revue et à la mise à jour de la documentation relative à la protection des données (politiques de confidentialité, DPA, procédures internes, etc.). Accompagner la Legal Team dans l'analyse de questions relatives au RGPD et à la protection des données dans le cadre des projets de l'entreprise. Contribuer à la sensibilisation des équipes internes aux enjeux de protection des données, notamment à travers la préparation et l'animation de courtes formations sur les notions fondamentales du RGPD et les bonnes pratiques à adopter au quotidien. 2. Droit du numérique & Intelligence Artificielle Participer à l'analyse des enjeux juridiques liés aux nouvelles technologies, aux solutions SaaS et à l'intelligence artificielle. Contribuer au suivi des évolutions réglementaires européennes, notamment du Règlement européen sur l'intelligence artificielle (AI Act), et à l'évaluation de leurs impacts potentiels sur les activités de Lengow. Participer aux réflexions et projets internes relatifs à l'utilisation de l'intelligence artificielle et à la mise en place de bonnes pratiques. 3. Contrats commerciaux & accompagnement des équipes Participer à la rédaction et à la revue de contrats commerciaux en français et en anglais (contrats SaaS, accords de confidentialité, contrats fournisseurs, accords de partenariat, etc.). Contribuer à l'analyse des clauses contractuelles, notamment celles relatives à la protection des données, à la confidentialité et à la responsabilité. Accompagner la Head of Legal dans le traitement des demandes juridiques des équipes opérationnelles. Participer à la mise à jour des modèles contractuels et des documents juridiques internes. 4. Veille juridique & projets transverses Assurer une veille juridique et réglementaire sur les évolutions en matière de protection des données personnelles, de droit du numérique et d'intelligence artificielle. Réaliser des recherches juridiques et rédiger des synthèses claires et accessibles pour les équipe

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Measurement & Reporting
jobs.description: Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. This is a unique moment to join Vibe. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. jobs.title: Junior Product Designer - UI/UX
jobs.description: You turn complex manufacturing data into interfaces factory teams rely on every day, working side by side with our engineers. Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We are a fast-growing team driving massive impact in one of the largest and most under-served industries in the world. We serve the world's top manufacturers across the globe. From Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, our customers trust us to make their factories run better. We are backed by leading investors like Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Google, Meta, Palantir, MBB, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity. WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT? You’ll join our small design team and work directly with our engineers. At first you’ll focus on UI: building screens, components and flows for our platform, and helping our design system grow. Over time you’ll take on larger parts of the product end to end. This is what you’ll do: Turn flows and concepts into detailed production-ready screens. Create and maintain components in Figma, keep them in sync with what’s in code, and notice when patterns start to drift. Pair with developers, review builds, and make quick trade-offs when something doesn’t fit the sprint. Your designs ship; you don’t just hand off Figma files. When a shortcut hurts the experience, you say so, explain why, and propose an alternative. And you know when good enough is good enough. Join customer calls and factory visits, test ideas with our forward deployed engineers, and bring what you learn back into the product. Help where a startup needs it: website updates, sales decks and marketing visuals now and then. WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING? First and foremost, we believe in curious people who are eager to learn and grow. If you're passionate about cutting-edge tech and driving major impact in manufacturing, we want to hear from you. You don’t need to have done it all. We can teach you manufacturing, our product, and a lot about designing complex B2B software. We can’t teach you to care about the details, or to be curious about how things work. Must-haves: You’re fluent in English and comfortable with changing priorities. You know when to be scrappy and when to be thorough. You have 1–3 years of professional experience designing digital products. Internships and working-student roles count if you shipped real work. You have strong UI craft and have hands-on experience with a design system. You’re fluent in Figma (components, variants, auto layout, variables) and comfortable using AI tools for quick iterations and prototypes. You enjoy working closely with developers and understand enough about frontend to design things that can be built. You can explain and stand behind your design decisions, and you change your mind when someone has a better argument. You’re curious about users, technology and how things get made, and you actively look for feedback so you can grow. Bonus: Experience with B2B SaaS, dashboards or data-heavy products WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU? We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person. You’ll work alongside two senior designers, get regular design critiques, and sit close to the engineers who build what you design. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct. Additionally, we offer: Performance-based career & growth paths On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation Flexible parental leave Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching I

Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. jobs.description: Research Engineer, Manipulation Data & Teleoperation — Zurich This role owns the data generation layer of Sereact's VLA stack: teleoperation systems and data collection infrastructure that feed Cortex, built from our Zurich research hub. About Sereact Sereact is a Series B embodied-AI company. Cortex, our VLA model, is deployed in live warehouse robotic cells across the EU and US. Zurich is our newest research hub, focused on the manipulation and control problems that sit underneath Cortex. The role This is a Research Engineer position. jobs.description: About the Role Imagine pioneering the mathematical and logical foundations that enable AI to fly safely in real-world, safety-critical aviation. As a Machine Learning Certification Researcher, you will address one of the most fundamental challenges in modern AI: proving that ML models are safe, reliable, and mathematically sound for deployment in autonomous flight. Your work will bridge the gap between cutting-edge statistical learning theory and formal aviation certification frameworks, building upon previous work (EASA CoDANN I and II, and FAA report DOT/FAA/TC-21/48), and putting real-world systems to the test. At Destinus, we are shaping the future of defense through high-speed, autonomous flight technologies. We develop next-generation unmanned aerial systems that deliver greater speed, precision, and efficiency, supporting governments and defense organizations in mission-critical operations worldwide. Daedalean AG, the AI and autonomy hub of the Destinus Group, plays a key role in this vision—developing safety-critical AI systems at the intersection of advanced research and real-world aviation. Enabling machines to perceive, understand, and make decisions in real time, we combine aerospace engineering and artificial intelligence to build the next generation of autonomous flight systems, driving innovation where it matters most. What You'll Do • AI Certification Strategy: Analyze our existing AI certification strategy and help adapt it—or pioneer entirely new strategies—to certify different supervised ML. • EASA Framework Alignment: Connect mathematical guarantees, technical arguments, and model evaluations to the EASA W-shaped process for AI certification in aviation, ensuring our research aligns with the latest regulatory guidelines. • Theoretical Foundation & Modeling: Conduct research into statistical learning theory, generalization bounds, and mathematical guarantees for deep neural networks operating under dynamic real-world conditions. • Uncertainty Quantification: Apply statistics and stochastic processes to model environmental uncertainties and sensor noise, and to quantify confidence in performance metrics. • Literature & Proof Evaluation: Critically evaluate academic literature, mathematical proofs, and engineering assumptions with peer-review rigor to identify safety limitations and theoretical gaps in state-of-the-art AI. • Regulatory & Audit Justification: Construct robust, logical arguments and technical justifications that translate complex, high-dimensional empirical data into structured evidence for safety audits and certification frameworks. • Algorithmic Validation: Write clean, reproducible code in Python to test theoretical hypotheses, validate certification mechanisms, and benchmark model safety frameworks. Requirements What You'll Need Machine Learning Theory & Mathematics • ML Theory & Statistical Learning: Deep understanding of statistical learning theory, generalization bounds, and the mathematical foundations of deep neural networks. • Statistics & Stochastic Processes: Strong background in advanced probability, statistical modeling, and stochastic processes. • Python Engineering: Proficiency in Python with the ability to write clean, reproducible code (can also be learned on the job provided strong theoretical foundations and basic Python coding). Research Rigor • Scientific Research Methodology: Demonstrated capability or background in conducting comprehensive literature reviews, identifying gaps in current state-ofthe-art AI, and synthesizing complex academic concepts into actionable engineering frameworks (can also be learned on the job if you possess a strong quantitative baseline). • Peer Review Expertise: Ability or experience in the peer-review process—capable of critically evaluating mathematical proofs, algorithmic assumptions, and research papers to assess their validity and limitations. jobs.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. The Role We are seeking a detail-oriented Mechanical Design Engineer to join our engineering team in Lausanne. In this role, you will lead the physical product design of hardware assemblies, mechanical housings, custom structures, and precision mechanisms, guiding products through CAD design, drafting, prototype verification, and industrialisation. From day one, you will own the transition of concepts into production-ready physical hardware. You will maintain strict product data management standards, apply geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, run thermal and stress analyses, work with suppliers across various manufacturing processes, and perform hands-on prototype assembly and testing. What You Will Do CAD Design & Drafting: Create clean, fully constrained CAD models, multi-part assembly layouts, and detailed engineering drawings following formal geometric dimensioning and tolerancing standards. Product Data & Configuration Management: Manage engineering change requests, update bill of materials data, maintain material libraries, and enforce configuration controls in digital product data systems. Prototype Assembly & Verification: Build physical prototypes, test assembly sequences, verify fit and tolerance stack-ups, and establish unit build procedures. Environmental & Stress Analysis: Perform structural, thermal, vibration, and mechanical shock simulations to ensure hardware survives harsh operational environments. Manufacturing & Supplier Integration: Work closely with suppliers to optimize designs for production methods such as CNC machining, stamping, pressing, forging, casting, and injection molding. CAD & Drafting Experience: Strong proficiency in production CAD environments with experience applying formal drafting standards such as ASME or ISO GD&T. Product Data Management: Practical experience with configuration management practices, engineering change notices, and product data systems such as Siemens Teamcenter or similar PDM/PLM tools. Manufacturing Tooling & Processes: Design experience across multiple manufacturing methods including machining, stamping, casting, forging, and molding. Analysis & Verification: Ability to perform basic environmental, thermal, shock, and stress evaluations to qualify hardware designs against operational requirements. Proactive Execution: Practical mindset with strong hands-on skills for prototype assembly, vendor management, and technical troubleshooting. What We Offer Opportunity to establish core mechanical design capability and elevate drafting standards within a growing engineering team.
