Your Day-to-Day: Lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical FEA of propulsion battery packs, PDUs, and their internal components, predicting how they behave under nominal operation and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions, and flight and inertial loads. Perform room-temperature and elevated-temperature analysis of composites (including sandwich structures), metals, adhesives, and mechanical fasteners, capturing temperature-dependent material behaviour. Build and correlate nonlinear models covering material, geometric, and contact nonlinearity – including cohesive-zone and VCCT delamination, composite progressive failure and damage propagation, metal plasticity and rate-dependent behaviour, crushable foam plasticity and densification, large-deformation and post-buckling response, and frictional contact with bolt pretension, including bearing behaviour at fastener holes (bearing yield, hole elongation, and bearing–bypass interaction). Model the hyper-elastic and viscoelastic behaviour of potting compounds, gap fillers, foams, gaskets, seals, and thermal interface materials to predict contact pressure and interface integrity across the life of the pack. Perform durability and life analysis across the differing service lives of components within the system, covering vibration-induced high-cycle fatigue (DO-160 random and sine sweep), low-cycle fatigue from ground–air–ground and charge/discharge thermal cycling, and fatigue of bonded joints, fasteners, busbars, and interconnects. Analyse thermal runaway response as a coupled thermomechanical event – pressure loads, direct impingement flow, ejecta, and heat transfer to surrounding structure and systems – working closely with the Thermal Systems team on thermal runaway CFD modelling and the resulting heat transfer boundary conditions, in support of containment and continued safe flight and landing. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.</p></div><p>The Architecture team at Tenstorrent is designing the central compute chiplet that powers our next generation automotive SoC. shape every design decision.</li> <li>How to integrate complex IP blocks and CPU subsystems into a coherent, shippable product.</li> <li>Why silicon architecture is a cross functional discipline, not jobs.title: Head of Product Compliance (f/m/d)
jobs.description: We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you. Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future. Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter. Help us see what's possible. Join us. Your Role Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Product, you will drive product quality management and regulatory compliance for Orbem’s cutting-edge systems across the EU, US, and other upcoming markets. You will serve as the strategic bridge connecting complex hardware, software, and AI capabilities with international safety and industry standards. Leading and scaling the product compliance team, you will ensure our products meet global market standards and internal quality requirements fast. Your Day-to-Day Enable Global Product Impact: Own compliance roadmaps for international market access, securing NRTL approvals and achieving CE marking through the Machinery Regulation and EMC Directive. Lead and Scale the Team: Mentor and grow the product compliance team, fostering a culture of continuous learning, fast delivery, and strong ownership. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with product development disciplines, Field Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Legal experts to embed compliance and quality management seamlessly into our product lifecycle. Close the Conformity Loop: Own the path from field and production nonconformances through root-cause analysis and CAPA into updated risk assessments, technical files, and design changes — so what we learn on site changes what we build. Stakeholder Enablement: Translate complex regulatory frameworks into clear guidance, facilitating alignment and smooth execution across multidisciplinary teams. Agile Framework Optimization: Maintain structured compliance guidelines while adapting processes to support the fluid pace of a fast-growing scaleup environment. Champion system validation processes to ensure product reliability. Own Regulated Product Documentation: Take accountability for operator, installation, and maintenance manuals, safety markings, and translations as conformity deliverables in their own right, leading the technical writers who produce them. Your Experience and Skills You have 10 + years experience in compliance and quality management and proven experience in a leadership role, ideally within an agile scale-up or high-growth tech environment. Experience overseeing complex systems that combine hardware, software, and AI, ideally involving special machinery or automation equipment. You have run nonconformance and CAPA processes for complex electromechanical products, with hands-on root-cause practice (8D, FMEA, fault tree or equivalent) and a track record of field failures actually changing designs. Broad knowledge of international product compliance frameworks, specifically UL508A and NFPA79 approvals, and CE marking under the Machinery Regulation and EMC Directive. You have defined quality and compliance requirements in stage-gate processes, and built Design for Compliance, and Design for Quality principles in the product development process. Track record of building, mentoring, and scaling technical teams. Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills with a collaborative leadership mindset. You are comfortable defining a common framework for acceptance criteria and verification evidence, including factory and site acceptance testing, calibration, and measurement traceability. What Makes You Stand Out Direct domain experience with industrial automation systems in the food process

jobs.description: About us At GotPhoto, we are freeing photographers to be more successful. Through our platforms GotPhoto.com and fotograf.de , we help professional photographers simplify and transform the way they work — from photo management and client communication to ordering and payment processing. Our end-to-end workflow and e-commerce solution gives photographers more time to focus on what matters most: being behind the lens. Since 2012, we’ve built a sustainable and profitable business driven by entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a deep understanding of photographers’ everyday challenges. Today, thousands of photographers trust our software , creating their own success stories along the way. As the leading e-commerce engine for professional volume photographers and a business backed by EQT, one of the world’s leading private equity firms, we’re powered by a team of 150+ talented and international people building technology that simplifies photographers’ everyday work and helps them focus on capturing meaningful moments. Join us on our journey to empower photographers like never before. AI Automation Specialist - Marketing & Web (all genders) Do you enjoy turning repetitive tasks into seamless AI automations? Evaluation & Prioritization : Apply a structured evaluation matrix (measuring efficiency gain, effort, and business impact) to pick high-value quick wins. Build, Automate & Measure: Build structured workflows, clean up tool knowledge bases, measure performance, and document processes for seamless handover and adoption by colleagues. You will lead the rebuild project from a marketing perspective, leveraging modern AI tools for copy generation, structure planning, SEO/GEO optimization, and content deployment. Anchor Project 2 : AI-Driven Design Workflows: Automate and streamline our visual asset creation. You will implement generative AI design workflows (e.g., using tools for visual asset generation, localization, scaling banner creation, or brand asset management) to elevate our creative output and reduce manual designer effort. Phase 2: Growth & Scaling (Your Path Forward) As you establish our AI design pipelines, maintain the rebuilt website, and master our marketing stack, your role will expand along a dedicated growth trajectory: Strategic AI Ownership: Shift from initial workflow setups to owning end-to-end AI initiatives across complex multi-channel marketing campaigns. Advanced Architecture & Custom Automation : Lead the optimization of centralized team knowledge bases, custom GPTs, and sophisticated multi-agent or API-based automations (e.g., using Make, n8n, or custom scripts). Enablement & Community: Become the core AI ambassador within marketing, driving up team-wide AI literacy, establishing prompt engineering standards, and collaborating with cross-functional AI peers across GotPhoto. Website Optimization & Web Operations: Evolve from web manager to growth op

jobs.title: 3D Reconstruction Research Scientist/Engineer
jobs.description: About Niantic Spatial AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time. That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are. In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right. Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us. About the Role You’ll join our Research Team in London as a 3D Reconstruction Research Scientist/Engineer — working at both ends of the pipeline, from cutting-edge academic research to shipping directly to customers. Our team builds the reconstruction technology that turns casually captured or domain-specific imagery into high-fidelity 3D reconstructions: everything from Structure-from-Motion through 3D Gaussian Splatting, feed-forward models, and generative models. We’ve shipped 360 splatting to consumers and enterprise customers, developed the splatting tech that runs on phones, and published at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, and SIGGRAPH — more often than not, our papers end up in production. You’ll work alongside world-class researchers in computer vision, machine learning, graphics, and robotics on large-scale spatial understanding, localization, reconstruction, scene understanding, and geospatial foundation models. This role is open to junior and senior researchers; scope and responsibility are calibrated to your experience. What You’ll Do Research & Publication — Conduct original research in 3D computer vision, machine learning, and spatial AI; publish findings at top-tier venues including CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, and SIGGRAPH. Algorithm Development — Design, implement, and evaluate novel algorithms across 3D reconstruction, neural scene representations, 3D Gaussian Splatting, SfM, meshing, geometric deep learning, feed-forward models, generative models, and spatial foundation models. Research-to-Production — Collaborate with research scientists and engineers to transition promising ideas into customer-facing products — working directly with real capture conditions, real hardware constraints, and real customers on short turnarounds. Large-Scale Experimentation — Build and run large-scale experiments and benchmarking frameworks to rigorously validate and advance new methods. Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration — Partner with world-class researchers in CV, ML, graphics, and robotics to advance large-scale spatial understanding, localization, reconstruction, and geospatial foundation models. Rapid Prototyping — Implement and iterate on state-of-the-art methods for both academic publishing and production deployment, delivering working prototypes to enterprise customers with speed and quality. What You’ll Bring PhD in Computer Vision, Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a closely related field — or equivalent demonstrated research experience in industry. A strong research track record in 3D computer vision: reconstruction, depth estimation, novel view synthesis, SfM, SLAM, or closely related areas. A meaningful publication record at top-tier venues (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, SIGGRAPH, NeurIPS, or equivalent). Strong programming skills in Python and hands-on experience with PyTorc

jobs.title: Head of Customer Experience
jobs.description: TL;DR: We're hiring a Head of Customer Experience to own how customers succeed with Lovable end-to-end — from first interaction to enterprise adoption. This isn't a traditional support leadership role: you'll build an agentic-first CX function from the ground up, sitting at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and GTM. This is an in-office role in Stockholm or London. Why Lovable? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. The Role We're hiring a Head of Customer Experience to own the full spectrum of how customers succeed with Lovable, from their first interaction to enterprise adoption. This is not a traditional support role. You'll own the function that sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and GTM and build feedback loops that make Lovable better. Everything you build should be agentic-first. We're not looking for someone who will staff up a classic support org — we want someone who will build this function around AI agents. What you'll do CX function — own ticketed support, async support, incident response, and onboarding. Agentic support infrastructure — architect and build AI-powered systems that resolve issues, surface product signals, and scale coverage without scaling headcount 1:1. The product feedback loop — you're the clearest signal we have on what's broken, confusing, or missing; you own turning that into structured input for Engineering and Product. Enterprise CX — build dedicated support motions, office hours, and success touchpoints for our largest customers. Social support — own Lovable's customer support presence and response across channels like Reddit, Discord, LinkedIn, and Twitter/X. CX metrics — own and move CSAT, resolution time, time-to-value, and NPS. What we're looking for 10+ years of experience, with at least 5 in a leadership role owning Customer Experience. AI-native operator — you're actively building agentic support systems today, not planning to "explore AI" in the future. Commercially accountable — you've owned NRR, churn, CSAT, or expansion targets and can cite specific results. Cross-functional fluency at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and GTM. Proven people leader — you've hired, developed, and retained CX managers and ICs across multiple time zones. Technical depth — comfortable working inside an engineering org, contributing to product direction, and building tooling. Preferred: background from AI-native or developer tools companies; experience scaling PLG support at high-growth tech companies; has contributed code or built internal tooling for support/CX infrastructure. About your application Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Uni

jobs.title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer – AI-Native Software Development
jobs.description: <p>At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have strived to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.</p> <p>We just unveiled JetBrains Central,&nbsp; a platform for agent-driven software development that connects tools, agents, and infrastructure. It enables automated AI workflows to run, be monitored, and be managed across teams – with clear visibility into results, costs, and performance.</p> <p>JetBrains Central provides three core capabilities:<br><strong>Governance and control: </strong>Policy enforcement, identity and access management, observability, auditability, and cost attribution for agent-driven work. Some of these functionalities are already available via the <a href="http://console.jetbrains.cloud/">JetBrains Central Console</a>.<br><strong>Agent execution infrastructure:&nbsp;</strong>Cloud agent runtimes and computation provisioning that allow agents to run reliably across development environments.<br><strong>Agent optimization and context:</strong> Shared semantic context across repositories and projects, enabling agents to access relevant knowledge, and task routing to the most appropriate models or tools.</p> <p>Inside the Professional Services department, we are building a team of Forward Deployed Engineers to help our customers adopt AI-native development with JetBrains Central and enable JetBrains consulting partners to transform their customers’ AI-native software development lifecycle.</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work directly with early adopter customers to deploy JetBrains Central platform into complex enterprise environments and help them move from experimental AI usage to governed, scalable AI-native development.</p> <p>You will act as a trusted advisor to customer engineering teams and consulting partners, while also mentoring other Forward Deployed Engineers and helping with complex deployments. In this role, you will help establish best practices for enterprise AI adoption and influence how organizations implement AI-driven software development.</p> <p>This role is often a strong fit for engineers who have previously served as Principal or Staff Engineers, Heads of Engineering, CTOs, or Solutions Architects and who enjoy working directly with customers while staying deeply involved with complex technical systems.</p> <p>This role combines consulting, architecture, and hands-on engineering. Your work in the field will directly influence how our platform evolves and how enterprises adopt AI-driven development.</p> <p>You will work directly with the world’s most innovative companies — our client base includes 420 of the Fortune 500 — ensuring they maximize the value of their JetBrains investments.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Deploy JetBrains Central platform into enterprise development environments, CI/CD systems, and internal developer platforms.</li> <li>Help organizations transition from ad-hoc AI experimentation to governed AI-native development workflows.</li> <li>Implement enterprise AI governance, including security policies, access management, and data privacy controls.</li> <li>Enable observability for AI-driven development to help organizations understand their AI usage and its impact on productivity, as well as their code-generation patterns.</li> <li>Design sustainable AI adoption strategies, including usage controls and cost visibility across multiple model providers.</li> <li>Integrate our cloud-based agen

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Attio is the CRM for agentic revenue. Designed for the most ambitious go-to-market teams, it gives companies the power to understand every customer, automate at scale, and build their go-to-market motion exactly as they need. We've raised $116M from some of the world's best investors: GV (Google Ventures), Redpoint, Balderton, Point Nine, and 01A. We hire builders who thrive on complex technical challenges, hold themselves to a high bar, and genuinely care about delighting the people who use what they build. The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier. If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place. About the role Our Engineering team tackles the toughest challenges, so our users never have to. Real-time infrastructure, AI-native architecture, and a frontend that feels effortless - all powered by a team that moves fast, thinks rigorously, and holds an exceptionally high bar for quality. We're looking for Platform Engineers who treat the platform as a product, with every engineer at Attio as its customer. You'll own the infrastructure, tooling and pipelines that let the rest of engineering ship quickly and safely, and you'll be accountable for keeping all of it reliable, fast and cost-effective as we scale. What you'll do Build and evolve our platform infrastructure as code (Terraform, Kubernetes, GCP), so every environment is reproducible, version-controlled and auditable. Own our CI/CD pipelines end-to-end, making builds, tests and deploys fast, reliable and secure for every engineer at Attio. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.&nbsp;</span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>As part of our broader IT team consisting of over 50 people, you’ll be a part of the IT Hardware team, which looks after IT infrastructure and IT Equipment in all Vinted warehouses across Europe. jobs.title: Senior Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: About Nabla Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes: Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes. AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems. Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks. Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems. About the Role We are scaling our healthcare AI platform, with more products, integrations and AI agents, and more protected health information (PHI) flowing through them. To keep pace, we're growing our security engineering team and looking for an exceptional Senior Security Engineer . Our cloud infrastructure handles highly sensitive healthcare data, so security is core to everything we do. Our engineers already ask the right questions every day: can we use a one-time token here? How long should it live? How do we scope this OAuth Client? You'll work directly with our Lead Security Engineer to bring real AppSec expertise into the product squads, and to strengthen security well beyond them. This is a hands-on, high-impact role. About half your time goes to AppSec , but it is deliberately a broad security engineering role, not a pure code-review or pentest job. You'll regularly cross into platform and cloud, CI/CD and detection, and you'll own problems from start to finish. Code scanning, SCA and AI-driven code review are already running, but there is no AppSec process to undo. The threat-modeling practice, the security review loop, the triage rhythm and the secure-by-default libraries don't exist yet. You'll build them and run them. If you're pragmatic, love working shoulder to shoulder with developers, and want your work to protect patients' most sensitive data, this role is for you. Responsibilities Partner with the product squads as their go-to security engineer: design reviews, per-feature threat modeling, and fast, opinionated answers on authN/authZ, tokens and session design. Secure our authentication and authorization surfaces (OAuth clients, one-time codes, multi-org tenancy, the Core API user API, embedded/postMessage SDKs) and hunt for BOLA, IDOR and broken access control before attackers do. Run the code-security findings loop: triage and prioritize results from our SAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanners and AI-driven code review, route them to the right owners with SLAs, and drive the dependency-vulnerability backlog down, fixing issues yourself when that's faster. Secure our AI/LLM features and internal agents, covering prompt injection, tool and permission scoping for autonomous agents, PHI leakage, de-identification assurance and model/API egress. Run the external testing program: scope and run pentests (web, mobile, backoffice), validate fixes, operate our vulnerability disclosure program, and stand up a bug bounty. Build secure-by-default guardrails (secure coding guidelines, hardened libraries and patterns, pre-commit and PR checks) so the secure path is the easy path. Qualifications 5 to 8+ years in security engineering, including at least 2 to 3 years in application or product security, or experience as a software engineer with a strong security focus. Deep understanding of modern web and API security: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, session and token design, multi-tenancy, and the OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10. You can find access-control flaws by reading code. Strong coder, comfortable reading and fixing production code (mostly Kotlin and Python, plus web, mobile and desktop clients) and automating in Python. Experience running threat modeling and security design reviews, and operating SAST, SCA and secrets scanning in CI with a real triage loop, not just a dashboard. Genuine breadth: comfortable moving between an API design review, a supply-chain hardening PR and an incident in the same week, and honest about what you don't know yet

Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. What You Will Do Write and own the firmware for our data-capture hardware: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots. Build real-time data acquisition: drivers, DMA, buffering, and streaming from many sensors at once without dropping a sample. Je ontwikkelt niet alleen machine-learningoplossingen, maar brengt ze daadwerkelijk naar productie en adviseert klanten over architectuur, technologie en de beste aanpak om duurzame businesswaarde te realiseren. Voor deze senior positie zoeken we een ervaren professional met minimaal 6 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met machine learning in professionele productieomgevingen. Wat ga je doen? Machine Learning Engineering bevindt zich bij BigData Republic op het snijvlak van Machine Learning, MLOps, Software Engineering, Data Engineering en Cloud Engineering. Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams bij klanten aan end-to-end machine-learningoplossingen: van probleemdefinitie en architectuur tot ontwikkeling, deployment, monitoring en optimalisatie. Je; analyseert complexe business- en technische vraagstukken en vertaalt deze naar robuuste ML-oplossingen; adviseert klanten en stakeholders over machine learning, MLOps, architectuur en technische keuzes; ontwikkelt en productionaliseert machine-learningmodellen; ontwerpt schaalbare ML- en MLOps-architecturen; bouwt production-grade software rondom machine-learningoplossingen; werkt aan deployment, CI/CD, model serving, monitoring en observability; werkt samen met Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Software Engineers en Cloud Engineers; helpt klanten en collega's inhoudelijk naar een hoger niveau; draagt actief bij aan kennisdeling en thought leadership binnen BigData Republic. De technische uitdagingen variëren van machine-learningmodellen met directe businessimpact tot toepassingen rond deep learning, generative AI, Large Language Models (LLM's), predictive modelling, causal inference en reinforcement learning. Bij BigData Republic zien we een machine-learningmodel niet als het eindproduct. Een model levert pas waarde wanneer het betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en beheersbaar in productie draait. Daarom benaderen we ML-oplossingen als volwaardige softwareproducten. Technologieën waarmee we veel werken zijn onder andere; Python Airflow Apache Spark Kafka Docker Tensorflow Pytorch Kubernetes Terraform AWS/ Azur/ GCP en private-cloud omgevingen Welke technologie je inzet, hangt af van het vraagstuk. We zoeken daarom geen engineer die simpelweg zoveel mogelijk tools kent, maar een ervaren professional die begrijpt welke technische oplossing in welke situatie passend is en waarom. Je werkt aan complexe data-, AI- en machine-learningvraagstukken voor grote organisaties in verschillende sectoren. Tegelijkertijd ben je onderdeel van een klein, informeel en inhoudelijk gedreven team van ervaren Machine Learning Engineers, MLOps Engineers, Data Engineers en Data Scientists. Kennisdeling en thought leadership zijn fundamentele onderdelen van BigData Republic. We organiseren iedere vrijdag kennissessies op kantoor, schrijven inhoudelijke artikelen, organiseren meetups en bezoeken en spreken op conferenties. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om je eigen expertise verder te ontwikkelen en tegelijkertijd collega's en klanten verder te helpen. Dit is nadrukkelijk een senior consultancyrol. jobs.title: Data & AI Consultant
jobs.description: Ben jij de consultant die niet alleen adviseert, maar ook daadwerkelijk de leiding neemt over de uitvoering? Die precies weet hoe een modern data platform eruitziet, welke architectuurkeuzes ertoe doen en hoe je een klant overtuigt om de juiste koers te varen? Dan zoeken wij jou. Bij BigData Republic bouwen we aan de data- en AI-ambities van toonaangevende organisaties. We zijn AI-native en combineren dit met diepgaande engineering kennis. Op deze manier bieden wij onze klanten technische begeleiding tot duurzame en innovatieve oplossingen. Als Data & AI Consultant ben jij de schakel tussen strategische visie en hands-on realisatie, een rol die we nu voor het eerst toevoegen aan ons team. Wat ga je doen? Je werkt bij onze klanten op het snijvlak van strategie en technologie. Je bent geen consultant die alleen analyseert en dat tot slides verwerkt. Jij hebt de regie van A tot Z, van hulpvraag tot en met implementatie. Je analyseert- en vertaalt de wensen van onze partners naar technisch elegante oplossingen, van platform engineering tot MLOps en AI implementatie. Vervolgens begeleid je de teams bij onze klanten die dit in productie brengen. Je vertaalt business-uitdagingen naar concrete data- en AI-strategieën en maakt dit inzichtelijk voor zowel C-level als engineering teams. Je adviseert over data-architecturen, platformen en technologiekeuzes (cloud, lakehouse, real-time, batch) en bent in staat dit inhoudelijk te verdedigen. Je leidt de implementatie: je stuurt data engineers en scientists aan, bewaakt de kwaliteit en houdt de grote lijn in het oog. Je bouwt een vertrouwensrelatie op bij de klant en groeit uit tot een vaste sparringpartner op directieniveau. Je draagt bij aan de inhoudelijke kennisbasis van BigData Republic via interne kennissessies, blogposts of externe presentaties. Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een data-gerelateerde rol, waarvan minimaal 3 jaar in een consultancy- of leidende positie. Je hebt diepgaande kennis van data-architectuurprincipes: data mesh, lakehouse, streaming vs. batch, governance en datakwaliteit. Je bent thuis op minimaal een van de grote cloudplatformen (Azure, AWS of GCP) en weet welke managed services wanneer worden ingezet. Je snapt hoe moderne AI-toepassingen werken (LLM's, ML-pipelines, MLOps) en weet hoe je ze verantwoord in productie brengt. Je communiceert helder: je maakt complexe technische materie toegankelijk zonder de diepgang te verliezen. Je werkt het liefst hands-on: je denkt niet alleen mee, maar pakt ook zelf door wanneer dat nodig is. jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.description: Wij zoeken geen recruiter die wacht op sollicitaties. adesso Nederland groeit. En de mensen die wij zoeken, zijn meestal niet actief op zoek naar een nieuwe baan. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Recruiter die recruitment écht beheerst. Iemand die begrijpt dat een vacature online zetten het begin is en niet de strategie. Je weet hoe je zelf de markt in gaat. Je searcht, sourcet, benadert en bouwt relaties op. Je probeert verschillende invalshoeken als een search niet werkt. Je kent LinkedIn Recruiter, maar weet ook dat sourcing meer is dan een paar zoektermen invoeren en InMails versturen. En misschien nog belangrijker: je hebt ideeën. Over waar we talent kunnen vinden. Over hoe we mensen kunnen benaderen. Over employer branding. Over onze propositie als werkgever. Over tooling, data, events, referrals, communities en alles wat ons kan helpen om betere mensen aan adesso te verbinden. Zie je een kans? Dan verwachten we niet dat je wacht tot iemand je vertelt wat je moet doen. Je pakt hem. Wat ga je doen? Je krijgt verantwoordelijkheid voor recruitment binnen adesso Nederland en werkt nauw samen met hiring managers en management. Daarbij ben je zowel strategisch als operationeel. Want senior zijn betekent bij ons niet dat je alleen adviseert. Je doet het ook zelf. Je: voert zelfstandig searches uit naar schaarse IT-professionals; bouwt talentpools op in plaats van pas te zoeken zodra er een vacature ontstaat; benadert kandidaten persoonlijk en weet hun interesse te wekken; experimenteert met nieuwe sourcingkanalen en manieren van benaderen; voert intakes met hiring managers en durft kritisch te zijn op het profiel dat zij zoeken; adviseert over haalbaarheid, arbeidsmarkt, salaris en recruitmentstrategie; voert gesprekken met kandidaten en begeleidt het proces van eerste contact tot hire; houdt overzicht over je vacatures en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het resultaat; gebruikt data om te begrijpen wat wel en niet werkt; komt zelf met voorstellen om recruitment slimmer en effectiever te maken; denkt mee over employer branding, referral recruitment, events en communities; bouwt mee aan hoe recruitment binnen adesso Nederland zich verder ontwikkelt. Je krijgt daarbij geen dichtgetimmerd recruitmenthandboek. We verwachten juist dat jij vanuit je ervaring kunt zeggen: “Dit werkt niet. Ik denk dat we het zo moeten aanpakken.” En vervolgens help je om het te realiseren. Wanneer ben je voor ons senior? Niet omdat er ‘Senior Recruiter’ op je LinkedIn-profiel staat. Voor ons zit senioriteit in hoe je werkt. Je hoeft niet gevraagd te worden om te sourcen je weet dat het onderdeel van je vak is. Als een search niets oplevert, concludeer je niet dat “de markt lastig is”. Je verandert je aanpak. Als een hiring manager een onrealistisch profiel zoekt, durf je dat gesprek te voeren. Als je ziet dat ons recruitmentproces beter kan, kom je niet alleen met het probleem maar ook met een voorstel. En als je een goed idee hebt, krijg je energie van het daadwerkelijk uitvoeren ervan. We zoeken iemand met stevige recruitmentervaring, bij voorkeur binnen IT, tech of consultancy. Maar het aantal jaren ervaring vinden we minder belangrijk dan wat je daadwerkelijk kunt. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Bouw dataplatformen die klaar zijn voor wat er morgen met data en AI gebeurt. Bij adesso zoeken we een Data Engineer die verder kijkt dan alleen het bouwen van pipelines. Iemand die nadenkt over hoe data wordt verzameld, gemodelleerd, ontsloten en gebruikt en die graag werkt aan moderne data-oplossingen binnen Microsoft Azure en Snowflake. Je werkt aan dataplatformen die organisaties daadwerkelijk gebruiken. Als basis voor reporting en analytics, maar steeds vaker ook voor machine learning, AI en agentic toepassingen. Jouw rol Als Data Engineer ontwerp en bouw je schaalbare data-oplossingen voor onze klanten. Je werkt aan het hele traject: van databron en architectuur tot een betrouwbaar platform waarop data daadwerkelijk gebruikt kan worden. Daarbij werk je voornamelijk binnen het Azure-ecosysteem en denk je mee over keuzes rondom architectuur, datamodellering, performance en schaalbaarheid. Je bent niet alleen degene die bouwt. Je begrijpt waarom bepaalde keuzes worden gemaakt, kunt hierover sparren met klanten en collega's en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van de oplossing. Wat ga je doen? ·       Ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van schaalbare data pipelines en dataplatformen; ·       Ontwikkelen van cloud-native data-oplossingen; ·       Integreren, transformeren en ontsluiten van data uit verschillende bronnen; ·       Ontwerpen en implementeren van moderne Data Warehouse- en Lakehouse-architecturen; ·       Toepassen van datamodelleringsmethodieken zoals Kimball en Data Vault; ·       Bouwen van betrouwbare datasets voor analytics, dashboards, machine learning en AI-toepassingen; ·       Werken met technologieën zoals Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory en Snowflake; ·       Optimaliseren van performance, schaalbaarheid, betrouwbaarheid en datakwaliteit; ·       Inrichten en verbeteren van CI/CD-processen en toepassen van DataOps-principes; ·       Meedenken met klanten over data-architectuur, integraties en technische keuzes; ·       Samenwerken met Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Data Architects en andere specialisten binnen ons Data & AI-team. Affiniteit met AI, automatisering of intelligente bedrijfsprocessen Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands Duits en Engels. Waarom adesso? Bij ons krijg je de ruimte om écht impact te maken. Je werkt samen met ervaren SAP-consultants, architecten en developers aan uitdagende projecten waar kwaliteit belangrijker is dan snelheid. Daarnaast bieden wij: Uitdagende SAP-projecten binnen de zorg én andere complexe sectoren. Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Een internationale SAP-community met honderden experts. Hybride werken en flexibele werktijden. Een ruim opleidings- en certificeringsbudget. Toegang tot internationale kennisgroepen en expert communities. jobs.title: Lead Software Engineering
jobs.description: Ben jij een ervaren software engineer of architect die inhoudelijk sterk wil blijven, maar ook graag een team verder brengt? Bij adesso Nederland zoeken we een Lead Software Engineering. Iemand die technologie, mensen en delivery bij elkaar brengt. Je bent niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van je team, maar blijft zelf dicht bij de inhoud en onze klanten. Je werkt met ervaren software engineers aan uitdagende klantomgevingen en helpt tegelijkertijd onze Software Engineering-practice verder uit te bouwen. Van Java en moderne frontendtechnologie tot cloud, architectuur en agentic software engineering. Geen rol waarin je alleen maar gaat managen dus. Je blijft onderdeel van het vak. Wat ga je doen? Als Lead Software Engineering geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 5 tot 12 consultants en developers. Je coacht collega's, helpt ze groeien en zorgt ervoor dat zij op projecten zitten die passen bij hun kennis, ervaring en ontwikkeling. Tegelijkertijd ben je betrokken bij onze klanten en projecten. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van delivery, denkt mee over architectuur en engineeringvraagstukken en springt bij wanneer een project inhoudelijk of organisatorisch extra aandacht nodig heeft. Je rol bestaat grofweg uit vier onderdelen: People & team Je voert 1-op-1's, begeleidt ontwikkeling en performance en helpt collega's bij hun volgende stap. Je zorgt voor een goede onboarding van nieuwe collega's en bent actief betrokken bij recruitment en selectie. Software Engineering & delivery Je blijft inhoudelijk betrokken bij software engineering en kunt zelf een leidende rol pakken op een technisch of architectuurvraagstuk. Je bewaakt kwaliteit, planning en risico's en zorgt dat onze teams voorspelbaar en professioneel leveren. Tegelijkertijd help je engineers zich ontwikkelen richting Agentic Engineering: minder tijd besteden aan het produceren van code en meer aan het definiëren van context, architectuur en kwaliteit, het orkestreren van agents en het reviewen en valideren van de output. Klanten & commercie Je ziet wat er bij klanten speelt en vertaalt dat naar kansen voor adesso. Je denkt mee in presales, voorstellen en bids en helpt oplossingen vorm te geven die technisch én commercieel kloppen. Bij bestaande klanten herken je mogelijkheden voor vervolgprojecten en uitbreiding. Daarbij verschuift de focus steeds meer van het leveren van capaciteit naar het realiseren van engineering outcomes: sneller bouwen, moderniseren en klanten helpen hun engineeringorganisatie toekomstbestendig te maken. Groei van onze Software Engineering-practice Je helpt bepalen welke kennis, technologie en capabilities we als team nodig hebben. Je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen onder andere Java, frontend, cloud, architectuur en Agentic Engineering en vertaalt die naar onze manier van werken. Je helpt daarmee niet alleen individuele engineers groeien, maar bouwt mee aan een schaalbare engineering capability binnen adesso. We zoeken geen klassieke people manager die de techniek inmiddels heeft losgelaten. We zoeken juist iemand die software engineering begrijpt én mensen kan meenemen in de ontwikkeling van het vak. Je hebt ruime ervaring binnen software engineering en hebt bijvoorbeeld gewerkt als Senior Software Engineer, Tech Lead, Lead Developer of Software Architect. Je hebt ervaring met Java en/of moderne software-architecturen en begrijpt wat nodig is om complexe softwareprojecten succesvol te leveren. Daarnaast: heb je circa 7–8 jaar of meer relevante ervaring binnen softwareontwikkeling en complexe projecten; heb je ervaring met het begeleiden, coachen of aansturen van andere engineers; kun je met zowel developers als klanten en management schakelen; begrijp je onderwerpen als delivery, capaciteit, kwaliteit en projectmarge; heb je ervaring binnen consultancy of projectmatige dienstverlening, of voel je je thuis in zo'n omgeving; vind je het interessant om mee te bouwen aan proposities, presales en klantrelaties; volg je ontwikkeling

jobs.title: Stagiair(e) Marketing
jobs.description: Ben jij een creatieve en enthousiaste student die zich wil ontwikkelen in de wereld van marketing en communicatie én waardevolle ervaring wil opdoen binnen een ambitieus team? Wie ben jij Jij bent een creatieve duizendpoot die barst van de ideeën en niet bang is om initiatief te nemen. Je houdt van aanpakken, denkt in mogelijkheden en weet meerdere projecten tegelijk te coördineren. Je helpt bij het ontwikkelen van campagnes voor onze leden, creëert pakkende content en werkt mee aan het vormgeven van promotiemateriaal. jobs.title: Specialist Productontwikkeling particuliere Verzekeringen
jobs.description: Wie ben jij Ben jij een besluitvaardige en energieke professional die met een frisse blik kijkt naar particuliere verzekeringen? Zie jij commerciële kansen voordat anderen ze zien? En krijg jij energie van het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van verzekeringsproducten die aansluiten op het leven van vandaag én morgen? Dan krijg je bij Univé de kans om écht impact te maken. Bij Univé krijg je de ruimte om invloed te hebben op onze particuliere verzekeringen. Je werkt aan producten die relevant zijn op momenten waarop onze leden zekerheid en ondersteuning nodig hebben. Bijvoorbeeld wanneer iemand aansprakelijk wordt gesteld voor schade of juridische hulp nodig heeft bij een conflict. Wat ga je doen Jij vertaalt klantinzichten, marktontwikkelingen en trends naar onderscheidende verzekeringsproposities. jobs.title: Head of Data Science
jobs.description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The role: We are looking for a Head of Data Science to build Paddle's data science capability from the ground up. Our Merchant of Record model gives us a data position no PSP or billing provider has: subscription and pricing context alongside granular payment-outcome data, across thousands of software businesses. This role exists to turn that into economic value by putting machine learning and agentic systems into production. The mandate is deliberately narrow and deliberately ambitious: data science at Paddle owns automated decisioning inside the product — traditional machine learning and agentic systems alike — not decision-support analytics. We have a long list of candidate opportunities than we can fund, spanning payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance. We have a working hypothesis about which of these pays back first, and we'll share it — but part of the job in your first quarter is to pressure-test it, size the alternatives yourself, and tell us where to start. This is a founding role, and for the first few quarters it is a building role more than a managing one. You'll be the only person in the function: doing the analysis, engineering the features, training and evaluating the models or agents, taking the first system live with our engineering teams — and then operating it, answerable for its uptime, its drift and its numbers. Once the first use cases are proving out, you'll hire and lead a hub-and-spoke team of data scientists and machine learning engineers embedded across our highest-value business areas. You'll report into the VP of Data and work in close partnership with Product, Payments, Engineering, Risk and Finance. What you'll do: Prioritise which opportunities have the biggest impact.. Build a value-based use-case backlog across payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance; size the leading candidates properly; and make the call on sequencing with the relevant Product, Risk, RevOps and Finance stakeholders. This gets refreshed quarterly. Personally deliver the first system end to end: the analysis and back-test, the features, the model, policy or agent, the deployment, and the shadow and A/B tests that prove it works. Not a spec handed to someone else to build. Operate what you deploy. Own monitoring, retraining, drift response, incident handling and rollback for live decisioning, alongside the engineering teams whose services call it — and set the expectation that the function runs its systems rather than shipping them. Work across both traditional ML and agentic systems, and be honest about which a problem actually needs: a propensity or uplift model, a policy of rules, or an agent with tools, evals against golden answer sets and trace-level observability. Several of our strongest candidate use cases point each way. Build and lead the team — hire senior data scientists embedded in value areas and machine learning engineers in the hub, and set the professional standards, shared methods and reusable components the function runs on. Establish the production stack alongside Data Platform and Engineering: reproducible training data, code and artefacts; a model registry; inference services with real latency, availability and rollback requirements; historically accurate features where decisions

More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently . Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process , including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to. Job Posted: 08/26 Location: Americas (North, Central and South America) Hi there! Zapier is hiring a Manager, Analytics & Strategy to lead our newly formed GTM Analytics team. This team is the central analytics home for Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Customer Ops, with a mandate to deliver trusted GTM insights, improve the quality and speed of decision-making, and turn repeated questions into durable self-service analytics assets. You will manage a team of embedded analysts supporting Marketing, Sales, and Support/Customer Ops. Your team will own the day-to-day analytics interface for GTM leaders: funnel reporting, campaign performance, sales and support analytics, forecasting inputs, recurring business reviews, dashboarding, metric definitions, and urgent executive questions. This is a hands-on analytics leadership role. we're looking for someone who has deep analytics judgment, strong SQL skills, and real GTM domain expertise. You might come from a sales analytics, marketing analytics, revenue analytics, finance, or investment banking environment. The common thread is that you know how to operate with urgency, precision, and a high quality bar, and you are energized by analytics work: scoping ambiguous business questions, pressure-testing numbers, coaching people through complex GTM data questions, and delivering clear recommendations under time pressure. This is not a pure people-management role. You should be able to lean into advanced analytics, understand core statistical concepts, and guide work on experimentation, forecasting, or segmentation when the work calls for it, but the center of gravity is analytics leadership: trusted reporting, business partnership, analytical QA, stakeholder management, and building a faster, more consistent operating model for GTM data. You should also be AI-native in how you work and excited to make this team a proving ground for self-service analytics, analyst automation, and governed AI-assisted data workflows. Our Commitment to Applicants Culture and Values at Zapier Zapier Guide to Remote Work Zapier Code of Conduct Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier About You You are a hands-on analytics manager. You have 6+ years of experience in analytics, finance, revenue operations, marketing analytics, sales analytics, business operations, investment banking, or a related field. You have managed analysts or analytics-adjacent teams for at least 3 years, but you are still comfortable rolling up your sleeves to review SQL, inspect a dashboard, pressure-test assumptions, and help frame the answer. You have strong GTM analytics expertise. You understand how marketing, sales, customer operations, and revenue motions fit together. You have worked with funnels, pipeline, bookings or ARR, campaign performance, sales productivity, support performance, forecasting, attribution, segmentation, or lifecycle analytics. You know how to translate GTM questions into metrics, cuts, cohorts, and recommendations that leaders can act on. You are excellent with SQL and analytical reasoning. You read and write SQL, reason about grain and joins, identify data quality issues, and coach analysts toward cleaner, more reliable methods. You are comfortable with statistics and advanced analytics concepts such as confidence intervals, incrementality, cohorting, regression, forecasting, and experiment readouts, and you know when to partner with Data Science for heavier modeling work. jobs.title: Product Analyst
jobs.description: Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand. Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence. About this role: As a Product Analyst at Liftoff, you'll turn complex data into rigorous analysis that informs product decisions across our machine learning-powered platform. You'll own the analytical needs of your product team end to end: identifying the right questions, executing the analysis, and presenting results that shape what gets built. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Machine Learning Engineers to define success metrics, evaluate experiments, and understand the drivers of user behavior and advertising performance. Responsibilities: Source, scope, execute, and present analyses for your product team, working independently from question to recommendation. Partner with Product Managers and ML teams to define and monitor key success metrics for product features. Design, analyze, and interpret A/B tests and other experiments with statistical rigor. Build and maintain dashboards and reports that enable transparent, self-service monitoring of product performance. Develop reusable SQL, analytical notebooks, and lightweight frameworks, including LLM-assisted workflows, to streamline recurring analyses. Investigate unexpected changes in product or business performance and clearly communicate findings and recommendations. Build a strong working knowledge of Liftoff's core data tables, your product area, and the wider product suite. Collaborate with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to ensure data quality, metric consistency, and reliable instrumentation. Document analytical approaches, assumptions, and methodologies to support reproducibility. Other duties as assigned. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in analytics Strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python for data analysis. Experience delivering analytical projects independently, from scoping through to presentation. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Familiarity with BI and visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Hex, or similar). Degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Location: This role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities in the Pacific Time Zone: California, Nevada, Oregon, and Washington (State). Travel Expectations: We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building. Compensation: Liftoff offers all employees a full compensation package that includes equity and health/vision/dental benefits associated with your country of residence. Base compensation will vary based on the candidate's location and experience. The following are our base salary ranges for this role: SF Bay Area, Los Angeles/Orange County, Seattle : $137,000 - $170,000 All other California, Nevada, Oregon, Washington state locations: $126,000 - $156,000 #LI-REMOTE Liftoff offers a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative work environment where employees are empowered to grow and make an impact. jobs.title: Lead BI Developer
jobs.description: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz , All About Cookies , and OnlyInYourState . We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies. Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment. We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries. WHY JOIN US? You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato . BASE SALARY: $120,000 to $150,000 per year, paid semi-monthly MUST HAVE: Expert SQL & Comfortable with Unstructured Complex Data : Extracts accurate insights from raw, unstructured data without relying on clean models Reporting Ownership & Data Literacy : Builds, standardizes, drives adoption, and leaves teams more data-literate Performance Marketing Optimization : Connects data directly to levers that move the business, i.e. campaign performance, conversion rates, or revenue per session Advanced LookML Development (or equivalent in Power BI / Tableau) : Architects complex models with full understanding of downstream impacts Curiosity & Business Depth : Asks questions first; driven to grow business knowledge to become a trusted analytical partner, not just a builder EXPERIENCE: Minimum 7 years in business intelligence or analytics with direct exposure to performance or affiliate marketing. The strongest candidates have owned reporting end-to-end, from pipeline to dashboard, worked with messy, complex, third-party data, and partnered closely with business teams to uncover meaningful trends, conduct retrospective analyses, and connect data work to decisions that actually moved the business. YOUR ROLE Launch Potato is looking for a Lead BI Developer to own the reporting infrastructure that powers decision-making across our Credit Cards, Make Money/Manage Money, Banking, and Marketplace verticals with a clear growth path into becoming a proactive analytical partner who helps the team see around corners. You'll be embedded with the business from day one, partnering closely with our Yield, Paid Media, and Account Management teams to uncover meaningful trends, conduct retrospective analyses across experiments, creatives, offers, seasonality, and CAC performance, and challenge the team with insights they aren't currently seeing. This is NOT a role for someone who wants to build dashboards and hand them off, it's for someone who cares deeply about whether the work they build gets used, understood, and acted on. Outcomes (Performance Expectations) 30 Days in: Actively engaged with stakeholders to audit what reporting the team is consuming and why, i.e. identifying discrepancies, redundancies, and inconsistencies across existing dashboards and beginning to develop a roadmap to standardize reporting across your verticals. 60 Days in: Bridging business context and data understanding by being able to articulate how assigned verticals make money and what the key performance levers are. Actively improving dashboard standardization while executing on ad hoc requests with accuracy and business context. 90 Days in: Dashboard standardization is in execution and a clear roadmap exists for how trusted data sources will be developed to improve the efficiency of data consumption. LookML structure is understood well enough to begin making changes with full awareness of downstream impacts. Working relationships with Yield, Paid Media, and Account Management are established. 6 Months in: Trust is built with the business

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Ads
jobs.description: Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games. Discord seeks a seasoned Data Engineer, focusing on our advertising product data. In this role, you will drive technical vision and strategy for ads data engineering in support of our ML initiatives while building and maintaining sophisticated data pipelines, datasets, and analytical tools. You will lead cross-functional initiatives to transform our advertising products through data-driven insights and mentor fellow engineers to deliver exceptional results. This role works heavily with Data Science, Machine Learning, and product. If leading technical innovation, architecting scalable solutions, and empowering teams through data excites you, we encourage you to make a move! What You'll Be Doing Design and own core ads data models : fact/dim tables, canonical datasets, and aggregation layers that power delivery, measurement, targeting, attribution, and ML use cases. Build and maintain the ML data that enables ads ranking, delivery, and targeting - including feature development, label generation workflows, intra-day training, and ML input observability to catch data quality issues before they degrade model performance. Build conversion measurement pipelines and integrate third-party attribution data - including Conversion Attribution and Mobile Measurement Partner (MMP) integrations (Adjust, AppsFlyer, Singular) - ensuring attribution accuracy and data parity across measurement surfaces. Build batch and near real-time pipeline infrastructure across the ads ecosystem - pushing toward lower-latency data for ML and reporting use cases on our BigQuery + dbt + Dagster stack. Partnering with Data Platform on launch and success of new data processing engines to support low latency requirements.. Develop data quality frameworks, monitoring systems, automated anomaly detection, and SLA infrastructure for critical ads pipelines at massive scale. Proactively identify foundational data infrastructure gaps - including those with broad implications across ML, measurement, and reporting - and design scalable, canonical solutions that multiple teams can depend on. Build systems from scratch in a rapidly evolving, greenfield advertising data environment - making sound architectural decisions with incomplete information and balancing short-term delivery with long-term infrastructure investment. Drive alignment across Data Science, ML Engineering, Ads Product, and GTM teams through clear narratives that connect data infrastructure decisions to business outcomes and revenue impact. Mentor engineers through technical challenges, code and design reviews, and ownership of complex projects - contributing to the culture and engineering standards of the Data Engineering team team. What you should have 5+ years of hands-on experience writing production code and architecting data pipelines with high-volume consumer data in advertising technology domains (ad delivery, ranking, targeting, identity, conversion measurement). Deep expertise in digital advertising data engineering - specifically in ads delivery, conversion measurement, attribution pipelines, or ML feature data infrastructure. Experience with Conversion Data and APIs, MMP integrations, or identity graph infrastructure is strongly valued. Demonstrated experience building data models in a greenfield or 0-to-1 environment where requirements change frequently, documentation is sparse, and architectural decisions are made with incomplete information. Expert-level SQL and Python . Strong ability to design performant, maintainable data models and write production-quality pipeline code. Proven hands-on experience with data quality audits, mon

jobs.title: Applied Scientist, Pro Growth
jobs.description: Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes. Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together. About the Applied Science Team We’re looking for applied scientists with deep expertise in machine learning, optimization, building data products, and/or statistical models. As part of a small product team you will have full ownership over your domain, so you should be a person who dreams big, then executes well. At Thumbtack, the Applied Science team is responsible for a wide variety of problems spanning AI, machine learning, statistics, and computer science: Improve customer and service provider matching. Matching and optimization algorithms are fundamental to Thumbtack’s product: we now service millions of matches per week. Identifying better matches between customers and service providers has an incredible impact on the experience of customers and professionals transacting on our platform. Model complex relationships in the presence of many confounding factors. Predictive modeling problems are everywhere across our product. Our team works to scope, design and implement machine learning models to support Thumbtack’s product and marketing. Characterize marketplace dynamics. Thumbtack’s marketplaces consist of thousands of active markets across our service categories and U.S. cities. Via exploratory data analysis and experimental design, our team works to understand trends and behaviors within these markets. Build AI features. Use state-of-the-art approaches such as large language models (LLMs), reinforcement learning and agentic workflows to enhance customer / pro experience, increase acquisition and marketplace efficiency, and to automate and enhance internal processes. Build a healthy marketplace. We evolve and manage the monetization mechanics of our marketplace, including defining the parameters that affect the prices we charge. The challenge Thumbtack constantly works to balance supply and demand across thousands of local markets and hundreds of service categories. The Pro Growth pod is responsible for the science behind acquiring and activating the right pros, at the right time, in the right markets, to keep the marketplace healthy and growing. As an Applied Scientist on Pro Growth, you’ll build models and experiments that shape who joins Thumbtack, how they get activated, how we forecast supply needs by market and trade, and how we accelerate time-to-value for new pros. We leverage machine learning, causal inference, and optimization to strategically grow and shape our pro supply base. Our work directly contributes to meeting demand projections, unlocking strategic partnerships, and ultimately enhancing customer experience and platform growth by ensuring a robust and high-quality supply of pros. You’ll work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers, product managers, and other applied scientists on a portfolio that ranges from incrementality and market forecasting to LLM-powered onboarding agents. You’ll own end-to-end: from problem framing, through experiment design, through deploying models to production, through measuring business impact. What you’ll do Initiate and drive applied science projects to completion, with a focus on the business impact of those projects on pro acquisition, activation, retention, and supply health.
